use_case_name: Monitor Current and Past Auction Status

claims.content: The Customer wants to monitor the current and past auction status of a specific product item, including whether each auction is active/live or closed and the date/time, bid-count, and winning-bidder details.

scope_contract.goal_statement: Monitor the current and past auction status of a specific product item.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The Customer views the history of a specific product item and sees its current/live or closed auction status, along with date/time, bid-count, and winning-bidder information.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The Customer has a specific product item whose current and past auction status they want to monitor.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The Customer has seen the current and past auction status details for that product item.
in_scope_actions: View the auction history of a specific product item
See current/live vs closed auction status
See dates/times, bid counts, and winning bidder information
See bid-history details such as SKU, last bid, SmartBid max bid, and winning bid
excluded_adjacent_actions: Checkout or payment for won items
variant_dimensions: Display of active vs closed auctions

claims.content: Customer
The Customer has a specific product item selected/identified whose current and past auction status they want to monitor.
The system has an auction history record for that product item, including auction status (Unscheduled/Scheduled/Current/Live/Closed), date/time, bid counts, and winning-bidder information.
The Customer enters the Product ID for the specific product item and clicks 'Go' to initiate the auction status view.
The Customer enters the Product ID for the specific product item and clicks "Go".
The system displays the search results in two sections: a top product summary section and a bottom auction history section.

The bottom auction history section lists each auction record with Auction Status (Unscheduled, Scheduled, Current/Live, Closed), Auction Sequence, Start Date/Time, End Date/Time, Reserve Amount, High Bid, Number of Bids, and Winner / High Bidder.
The Customer selects the "Bid History" action for the product item.

The system displays the Bid History section, including the item's closing date/time (or "Active" if the auction is still live), auction sequence numbers, product ID (SKU), the customer's last bid, their SmartBid (max bid) if one was placed, and the winning bid regardless of who placed it.

The customer views the Product Details page for a specific item, which displays the Current High Bid, Open/Close Date/Times, Time Remaining countdown, and a table of Item Bid History showing Name, Amount, Date Placed, and SmartBid User status.

Diverges from Step 4: Instead of selecting the 'Bid History' action, the Customer clicks the 'Recently Ended Auctions' link. The system displays the 'Recently Ended Auctions' page, which shows 24 hours of auction history, giving the Customer an alternative scope for monitoring recent past/current auction status.

Diverges from Step 4: Instead of selecting the 'Bid History' action, the Customer clicks the 'Export to Excel' button under the search results. The system generates a CSV file of all data in the search results, allowing the Customer to capture and manually track the auction status information.

At main flow step 1, when the Customer enters a Product ID and clicks 'Go', if the search returns no matches, the system displays a 'No Results' page. The page includes a 'Search Tips' section advising the Customer to check for typos/misspellings, remove unnecessary words like 'and', 'the', or 'a', try plural and singular forms, use fewer or more generic keywords, and contact support if the tips fail. Exit path: the Customer is directed to Customer Support if the search tips fail.

The system displays the search results for the specified product item in two sections: a top product summary section and a bottom auction history section, with each auction record listed on a separate line showing Auction Status, Auction Sequence, Start Date/Time, End Date/Time, Reserve Amount, High Bid, Number of Bids, and Winner / High Bidder.

The system displays a Bid History section for the product item, including each auction's closing date/time (or 'Active' for live auctions), auction sequence numbers, product ID (SKU), the customer's last bid, their SmartBid if placed, and the winning bid regardless of who placed it.
The system displays the Item Bid History table on the product item's Product Details page, listing each bid with Name, Amount, Date Placed, and SmartBid User status.

inconsistency_hints: The main flow's Bid History display (step 5) covers closing date/time, auction sequence, SKU, the customer's last bid, SmartBid, and winning bid, but it does not include the Product Description/Specifications section or the per-bid Item Bid History table (Name, Amount, Date Placed, SmartBid User?) asserted by postcondition 3. Postcondition 3 is therefore not reasonably reachable from the main flow.

Postcondition 3 requires an Item Bid History table on the Product Details page listing each bid with Name, Amount, Date Placed, and SmartBid User status. The main flow only displays a Bid History section with auction-level summary fields and never navigates to the Product Details page or shows that table, so the main flow cannot lead to postcondition 3.

citation_audit.description: Latest model-authored candidates after internal semantic grounding verification and DRA; aligned with delivered slots.
